description: This Java class 'PayPalServices' provides methods for integrating with PayPal's NVP API, including setting up express checkout, updating checkout details, and handling transactions like authorization, capture, void, and refund. It manages PayPal API communication, cart and address handling, and error processing within an e-commerce context.

classes.name: PayPalServices.TokenWrapper
classes.description: A serializable wrapper class for PayPal checkout tokens, with overridden equals and hashCode methods for use as map keys.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initializes PayPal express checkout, sets cart details, and retrieves a checkout token from PayPal.

methods.name: payPalCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates checkout details with PayPal, creates or updates shipping address, and prepares the cart for payment.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Retrieves details from PayPal for a given checkout token, creates customer and address records if needed, and updates the cart.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes the PayPal express checkout process, finalizing payment and updating payment method info.

methods.name: doAuthorization
methods.description: Performs a PayPal authorization transaction for a given order.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction amount.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids a PayPal authorization or transaction.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a captured PayPal transaction.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodGatewayPayPal
methods.description: Retrieves the PayPal payment gateway configuration based on context, such as product store or payment setting.

methods.name: sendNVPRequest
methods.description: Sends an NVP request to PayPal and returns the decoded response.

methods.name: getCountryGeoIdFromGeoCode
methods.description: Fetches the geoId for a country based on its geoCode.

methods.name: parseStateProvinceGeoId
methods.description: Determines the geoId for a state or province based on PayPal's returned code and country.

methods.name: getErrorMessageMap
methods.description: Extracts error messages from PayPal's NVP response decoder.

methods.name: addCartDetails
methods.description: Adds cart item details to the NVP encoder for PayPal API requests.
